context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Dashboard refactoring complete. AdminDashboard.jsx reduced from 1346 to ~300 lines. Extracted components: AdminUsersManagement, AdminSubscriptionsManagement, AdminPaymentsManagement, AdminTicketsManagement. New Weekly Reports feature at /admin/weekly-reports with backend API at /api/weekly-reports/*. Fixed bug in AdminWeeklyReports.jsx where adminAPI.get/post were used instead of specific methods.
